purpose: Source-verified application composition roots used to derive composition reachability. A root declaration does not invent runtime edges; the generated edges come from the pinned source dependency graph.

roots.title: API protected runtime composition
roots.rationale: The source explicitly states this is the only composition root binding planner, validator, adapters, stores, auth and runtime services into ProtectedRuntimeModule.

roots.title: Temporal worker runtime composition
roots.rationale: Public worker runtime entrypoint assembling resources, host and lifecycle handle.

roots.title: Outbox worker runtime composition
roots.rationale: Creates PostgreSQL state, event bus, outbox runtime, purge and retention runtimes.

roots.title: Projector worker process composition
roots.rationale: Process entrypoint directly creates the PostgreSQL adapter and ProjectorWorkerRuntime.

roots.title: Lineage worker bootstrap composition
roots.rationale: Creates the PostgreSQL state adapter and OpenLineage sink behind the worker bootstrap result.

roots.title: Web application bootstrap
roots.rationale: Browser process bootstrap; included to prove which registered DVT workspaces are composition-reachable from the UI source graph, if any.
